title: Lake Placid 3
description: Game warden Nathan Bickerman moves his family to Black Lake, where his son discovers a clutch of baby crocodiles that, as they grow, begin to feast on humans.

title: Against All Odds
description: A Los Angeles bookie (James Woods) hires an ex-football star (Jeff Bridges) to find his runaway mistress (Rachel Ward) in Mexico.

title: 7 Seconds
description: Gangsters kidnap a thief (Tamzin Outhwaite) after her partner (Wesley Snipes) mistakenly steals a highly valuable painting.

title: The Devil's Own
description: A New York policeman (Harrison Ford) learns that his Irish houseguest (Brad Pitt) is an IRA terrorist seeking U.S. weapons.

title: Roman J. Israel, Esq.
description: Roman J. Israel is an idealistic defense attorney who joins another law firm after the death of his boss and mentor. Israel's legacy of activism soon gets put to the test when he takes on the case of Langston Bailey, a young man accused of murder.

title: Battle: Los Angeles
description: After the world's great cities fall, a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon make a last stand against alien invaders.

title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
description: An agnostic lawyer defends a Roman Catholic priest accused of negligent homicide during the exorcism of a college student.

title: Enough
description: After running away fails, a terrified woman (Jennifer Lopez) empowers herself in order to battle her abusive husband (Billy Campbell).

title: Anaconda
description: A snake hunter (Jon Voight) commandeers a documentary crew (Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube) in the Brazilian jungle, forcing them to battle a monster boa.

title: Quarantine
description: Trapped in an apartment building, a reporter (Jennifer Carpenter) and her cameraman (Steve Harris) record the outbreak of a horrifying disease that turns humans into voracious cannibals.

title: Darkness Falls
description: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.

title: Runaway
description: Two police officers (Tom Selleck, Cynthia Rhodes) of the future hunt a bad batch of robots programmed to kill by a madman (Gene Simmons).

title: Fire on the Mountain
description: A developer (Ron Howard) helps an old rancher (Buddy Ebsen) defend land the Army wants for a missile base.

title: Ike: Countdown to D-Day
description: Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower (Tom Selleck) faces monumental decisions in the 90 days leading to the Allied invasion of Normandy in 1944.

title: Final Descent
description: A pilot (Robert Urich) and co-pilot (Annette O'Toole) have limited options to land a jumbo jet after a severe midair collision.

title: Final Run
description: A man (Robert Urich) tries to stop a computerized train that is speeding out of control and headed for a large hospital.

title: Desperate Measures
description: To save his terminally ill son, a San Francisco policeman (Andy Garcia) arranges for a sociopathic killer (Michael Keaton) to donate bone marrow.

title: The Principal
description: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up.

title: Suspect
description: A Washington lobbyist (Dennis Quaid) on jury duty helps a public defender (Cher) save a deaf-mute vagrant (Liam Neeson) accused of murder.

title: Miss Bala
description: A woman finds herself in big trouble when a cartel leader forces her to do his dirty work to save her kidnapped friend. Determined to get away, she must now play a dangerous game to outwit the gang -- and the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity.

title: Quarantine
description: Trapped in an apartment building, a reporter (Jennifer Carpenter) and her cameraman (Steve Harris) record the outbreak of a horrifying disease that turns humans into voracious cannibals.

title: The Cave
description: Deadly monsters hunt members (Cole Hauser, Morris Chestnut, Eddie Cibrian) of an exploration team within a vast network of caverns beneath the Carpathian Mountains.

title: The Lazarus Project
description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

title: The China Syndrome
description: A TV reporter (Jane Fonda) and her cameraman (Michael Douglas) tour a California nuclear-power plant and see the cover-up of a meltdown crisis.

title: Dirty
description: Two corrupt Los Angeles policemen (Cuba Gooding Jr., Clifton Collins Jr.) endure separate investigations from Internal Affairs.

title: Stealing Harvard
description: A nitwit (Tom Green) persuades his down-to-earth friend (Jason Lee) to commit robbery to pay for college tuition.

title: Hanky Panky
description: Good guys and bad guys chase an architect (Gene Wilder) and a dead man's sister (Gilda Radner) for the wrong reason.

title: Simon Sez
description: A tattooed Interpol agent (Dennis Rodman) helps an old classmate (Dane Cook) find the kidnapped daughter of a computer software tycoon.

title: Krull
description: A prince (Ken Marshall) needs a razor-tipped boomerang to free his beloved (Lysette Anthony) from the fortress of the Beast.

title: Lake Placid 3
description: Game warden Nathan Bickerman moves his family to Black Lake, where his son discovers a clutch of baby crocodiles that, as they grow, begin to feast on humans.

title: The 6th Day
description: When a man (Arnold Schwarzenegger) discovers he has been illegally cloned, he must outrun assassins trying to protect their secret experiment.

title: Anaconda
description: A snake hunter (Jon Voight) commandeers a documentary crew (Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube) in the Brazilian jungle, forcing them to battle a monster boa.

title: Obsessed
description: A successful, happily married executive (Idris Elba) becomes the object of unwanted affection from a temp worker (Ali Larter) at his company.

title: Home Invasion
description: A mother (Veronica Hamel) and daughter (Bonnie Root) try to outwit robbers holding them and three friends captive.

title: ATF
description: The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms pieces together crime scenes.

title: Rolling Thunder
description: An experimental team of covert operatives, whose headquarters are beneath a hip nightclub, wage war on crime.

title: Quicksilver
description: A hotshot stock-exchange floor trader (Kevin Bacon) loses his shirt and becomes a bicycle messenger in a hilly city.

title: Lone Star State of Mind
description: A Texas mechanic tries to save a dimwitted relative from gangsters.

title: Facing the Giants
description: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.

title: Miracle on the Mountain: The Kincaid Family Story
description: Injured when their private plane crashes into a snowy mountain, a domineering man (William Devane) and his family (Patty Duke, Elisabeth Rosen) face an avalanche and bitter winds.

title: Into Thin Air: Death on Everest
description: Climbers (Peter Horton, Nat Parker, Christopher McDonald) scale Mount Everest in 1996, but a blizzard kills several in the expedition.

title: Toy Soldiers
description: When Colombian drug terrorists hold a Virginia prep school hostage, some of the rowdier boys (Sean Astin, Wil Wheaton, Keith Coogan) fight back.
